annotations.title: Set when a new error alerts

description: When a new error alerts: on its first event (people 1, the default) or once it hit 2, 3, 5, 10 or 25 people. Errors on checkout, signup, login, pricing or home, and resolved errors that return, always alert at once. Errors with no user count events instead. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

keyPages.description: The app's own key pages on top of checkout, signup, login, pricing and home: exact paths or prefixes ending in *, like ["/start", "/app/new*"]. Errors there rank higher and always alert at once. [] clears them; left out keeps them.

name: set_error_alert
title: Set when a new error alerts
